mapper.select: select pid,rel_number as relNumber,rel_name as relName ,rel_type as relType,rel_Trade_Amount as contractAmount,MAJOR_TRADE as majorTrade,pricing_policy as pricingPolicy,is_agreement as isAgreement , TRAN_TYPE as tranType from ins_tra_business where (MAJOR_TRADE ='0'or is_agreement='0') and status in ('6','9','12') and (Archiving_Status is NULL or Archiving_Status <> '1')and delflag_='1' union all select pid,rel_number as relNumber,rel_name as relName,rel_type as relType,rel_Trade_Amount as contractAmount,MAJOR_TRADE as majorTrade,pricing_policy as pricingPolicy,is_agreement as isAgreement ,TRAN_TYPE as tranType from ins_tra_interest where (MAJOR_TRADE ='0' or is_agreement ='0') and status in ('6','9','12') and (Archiving_Status is NULL or Archiving_Status <> '1')and delflag_='1' union all select pid,rel_number as relNumber,rel_name as relName,rel_type as relType,rel_Trade_Amount as contractAmount,MAJOR_TRADE as majorTrade,pricing_policy as pricingPolicy,is_agreement as isAgreement , TRAN_TYPE as tranType from ins_tra_service where (MAJOR_TRADE ='0' or is_agreement ='0') and status in ('6','9','12') and (Archiving_Status is NULL or Archiving_Status <> '1')and delflag_='1' union all select pid,rel_number as relNumber,rel_name as relName,rel_type as relType,rel_Trade_Amount as contractAmount,MAJOR_TRADE as majorTrade,pricing_policy as pricingPolicy,'1', TRAN_TYPE as tranType from ins_tra_investment where (MAJOR_TRADE='0') and status in ('6','9','12') and (Archiving_Status is NULL or Archiving_Status <> '1')and delflag_='1' union all select pid,rel_number as relNumber,rel_name as relName,rel_type as relType,rel_Trade_Amount as contractAmount,MAJOR_TRADE as majorTrade,pricing_policy as pricingPolicy,'1' ,TRAN_TYPE as tranType from ins_tra_other where (MAJOR_TRADE='0') and status in ('6','9','12') and (Archiving_Status is NULL or Archiving_Status <> '1')and delflag_='1';
